dev.title: For developers
dev.text_hint: The same scenario as text. The changes made here show up in the form.

editor.name: Name
editor.about_hint: For you: what this scenario is for. The bot does not read it.
editor.warnings: Notes: {n}. They do not stop the scenario from working.
editor.unsaved: There are unsaved changes. Leave without saving?

status.viewing: this is not the working one: version {v} works
status.no_channels: Not switched on in any channel, so the bot never starts it.

lang.title: Language of the texts
lang.hint: Write in the main language — the bot translates into the others itself. A translation can be corrected.

step.leave: If the client changed their mind or went silent

sum.start_never: With these settings the scenario never starts
sum.questions: Questions: {n}, in this order. The bot does not ask again what the client already said
sum.confirm_on: The bot shows everything collected and asks “Is everything correct?”
sum.confirm_off: The bot does not ask to confirm: the request is ready at once
sum.next_all: The request is ready as soon as all answers are collected.
sum.next_event: The request goes to your system, the bot waits for its answer.
sum.next_event_hours: The request goes to your system, the bot waits for its answer up to {n} h.
sum.next_receipt: The request is ready when the payment receipt is accepted.
sum.leave_always: A refusal closes the scenario. After a pause the bot goes on from the same place
sum.leave_hours: A refusal closes the scenario. After a pause the bot goes on if less than {n} h passed
sum.catalog: from the catalog, up to {n} to choose
sum.date: a date, at most {n} days ahead

start.lead: The bot starts this scenario when the client:
start.own_placeholder: For example: does the client want to book or ask about a free time?
start.names_hint: — the message already answers this question
start.add_field: The client answers one of the questions
start.only: only {sign} — the bot just answers the question
start.exact_show: Fine tuning: points and the threshold
start.exact_hint: Every sign has points. The bot adds up the points of the signs it found in the message and starts the scenario when the sum is not less than the threshold. “This is enough” means the sign has as many points as the threshold.

q.title: Name in the request
q.title_hint: Only you see it: in the request and in the lists here.
q.ask_hint: This is a hint: the bot words the question anew every time.
q.catalog_how: How the bot offers the items
q.receipt_hint: The bot reads the receipt itself and checks the amount, the currency, the date and the recipient. Who looks at the receipts after that is set in Settings.
q.receipt_amount_field: Or the price of the item from
q.filter_placeholder: For example: did the client give both a first and a last name?
q.filters_hint: Write it as a question with a yes / no answer. If a condition does not hold, the bot politely asks again.
q.description_hint: What counts as a good answer. Helps the bot to ask and to understand the answer.
q.after_hint: The bot asks this question only when the chosen ones are answered.
q.key_hint: Under this name the answer goes into the request JSON. Lowercase Latin letters, digits and an underscore.
q.remove_confirm: Delete the question “{name}”? Everything that refers to it goes with it.

confirm.on: Show the client the answers and ask to confirm
confirm.hint: If the client corrects something, the bot shows the summary once more.
confirm.off_hint: Without it the request is ready as soon as the last answer is collected.

mode.all_fields: At once, when all answers are collected
mode.external_event: When your system answers (a CRM, a booking system)
mode.receipt: When the payment receipt is accepted

mode_hint.all_fields: The simplest way: the bot collected everything — you got the request.
mode_hint.external_event: The bot sends the request and waits: booked, the time is taken, failed.
mode_hint.receipt: Needs a question with the answer “A payment receipt”.

next.events_hint: For every answer: what it means and what the bot writes to the client.
next.event_say: The bot writes to the client
next.say_hint: The client's answers can be put into the text:
next.add_event: Add an answer of the system
next.wait: Wait for the answer up to
next.wait_label: How many hours to wait for the answer
next.wait_hint: If the system stays silent longer, nothing is written to the client and the request is closed as unfinished. Empty — wait without a limit.
next.events_dev: For developers: how the system reports its answer
next.actions_hint: Send the request, notify, write to the client or call a person.
next.no_actions: No actions yet: the request only appears in “Requests” here and is sent nowhere.

on.field_stuck: The client cannot answer a question
on.waiting: The request is ready and waits for your system

do.http_post: Send the request to your system

next.handover_hint: The bot goes silent in this conversation, it appears in the Inbox as “Waits for a person”.
next.approval: Only after a person approves it in the Inbox

leave.cancel: The client changed their mind — how to tell
leave.cancel_placeholder: For example: the client says they changed their mind or asks to stop.
leave.cancel_hint: Describe it in plain words. Then the bot closes the scenario and sends nothing.
leave.resume: The client came back after a pause
leave.resume_always: Go on from the same place, whenever they come back
leave.resume_within: Go on only if no more than this passed:
leave.resume_hours: How many hours to wait for the client
leave.resume_hint: A booking makes sense for a day, a questionnaire can be continued in a week. After the limit the scenario is closed as unfinished.
leave.incompatible: Do not start while this one is going
leave.incompatible_hint: For example, a booking and its cancellation: only one of them at a time.

preview.title: How the client sees it
preview.sub: An example of the conversation. Changes together with the scenario.
preview.client_starts: the client writes what they want
preview.question: question “{name}”
preview.waiting: step 4 — the request went to your system

problem.never: With these settings the scenario never starts: all signs together do not reach the threshold.
problem.sign_empty: Sign {n} is empty: describe it in words.
problem.bad_scenario_key: The scenario key is not valid (see “field keys” at the bottom).
problem.key_taken: The key “{key}” already belongs to another scenario (see “field keys” at the bottom).
problem.bad_key: The question “{name}” has a key that is not valid.
problem.no_question: The question “{name}” has no text: what to ask.
problem.few_options: The question “{name}” needs at least two options.
problem.option_empty: The question “{name}” has an empty option.
problem.filter_empty: The question “{name}” has an empty condition.
problem.no_events: Not set what your system may answer.
problem.event_code: An answer of the system has a code that is not valid: lowercase Latin letters, digits and an underscore.
problem.event_reopen: For the answer “{name}” choose what to ask again.
problem.no_receipt: There is no question with the answer “A payment receipt”.
problem.resume_hours: Set how many hours to wait for the client to come back.

save.problems: Not everything is filled in — the scenario may not be saved:
save.activate: Turn it on at once: the bot uses this version from the next message
save.channels: Where the bot runs this scenario
save.channels_hint: Without a channel the scenario is saved but never starts.

list.sub: A scenario is a conversation in which the bot learns everything needed from the client and hands you a ready request.
list.no_channels: not switched on in any channel
list.empty_sub: Take a ready one and adjust it, or build your own question by question.

new.words_title: Describe in your own words what the bot should do
new.words_sub: The bot will put the questions together itself. You only check and fix them.
new.words_placeholder: A client books a haircut. Find out the service, the day and the time, the name and a phone.
new.words_hint: Where to send the finished request is chosen later, in the step «What next».
new.words_busy: Making the draft… It usually takes up to half a minute.
new.words_done: The draft is ready. Check the questions and save.
new.templates_title: Or take a ready one and adjust it
new.templates_error: Could not load the ready scenarios.
new.blank_sub: You add the questions yourself, one by one.

file.title: A scenario from a file
file.sub: Choose a scenario file: it is checked and starts working at once. Nothing has to be restarted.
file.drop_title: Drag files here or choose them
file.drop_hint: Files .yaml, .yml or .json — one scenario in each.
file.load_error: Could not find out which scenarios you already have: {error}

what.new: A new scenario. It starts working right after the upload.
what.version: Becomes version {next} of the scenario «{title}» and replaces the working version {v}.
what.version_off: Becomes version {next} of the scenario «{title}». The scenario is switched off now — it will be switched on.
what.same: The file is the same as the working version {v}. Nothing to upload.
what.nowhere: Not switched on in any channel, so the bot does not start it. Open the scenario to switch it on.

file.bad_type: This is not a scenario file: .yaml, .yml or .json is needed.
file.too_big: The file is too big: more than 500,000 characters.
file.unreadable: The file could not be read.
file.same_key: Another chosen file already has a scenario with the key {key}.
file.warnings: Remarks: {n}. They do not stop the upload
file.channels_hint: For new scenarios and for those not switched on anywhere yet. A scenario that already works in a channel stays there.
file.no_channels: The bot has no channel yet, so the scenario will be saved but will not start.
file.done_note: Dialogues that already go by these scenarios finish by their previous version. To check the new one, start a new dialogue.
file.how_sub: A file is plain text: the bot's questions, the checks of the answers and what to do with the result. The format description has every setting and a ready example.
file.how_existing: The file of a scenario you already have: open the scenario, then «For developers» → «download as a file».
file.format_language: The description is written in Russian.
file.card_sub: A scenario written as a text file. It is checked and starts working at once.

err.extra: an unknown name — check for a typo
err.pattern: written against the rules. A key is small Latin letters, digits and single underscores, starting with a letter
err.text: a text is expected here. A number, a time or a date goes in quotes
err.nested: settings are expected here, as «name: value» lines
err.not_scenario: this is not a scenario: the file must consist of «name: value» lines
err.bool: true or false is expected here
err.empty_list: empty — at least one item is needed

file.no_language: No text in the language {language} in {n} places: {paths}
